known_issues.finding: Used frame index 7 at source cell [3,1] is fully transparent.
known_issues.harness_action: Reject a regenerated sequence containing any blank used frame; replace or intentionally remove the frame and update frame_count.

known_issues.finding: Scene paths use monster_lingnan1 but the disk directory is monster_Lingnan1.
known_issues.harness_action: Emit canonical case-exact res:// paths and fail path-case validation before Linux/Web export.

known_issues.finding: SpriteFrames uses 15 fps, but melee hit and lock timing uses boss_attack_fps=12, hit_frame=9 and total_frames=16. Visual duration is 1.067 s; gameplay hit is at 0.75 s and lock ends at 1.333 s.
known_issues.harness_action: Treat timing as an explicit integration decision; do not infer gameplay timing from sheet fps.

known_issues.finding: Each visual has 16 frames at 18 fps (0.889 s), while code selects attack for only attack_animation_duration=0.4 s.
known_issues.harness_action: Place the readable contact pose within the first 0.4 s or change runtime timing separately.

known_issues.finding: The two PNG files are byte-for-byte identical, so movement has no distinct walk cycle.
known_issues.harness_action: Generate a distinct walk cycle while preserving the 64x64, 12-frame, 4x3 contract.

known_issues.finding: The hit animation is configured to loop even though it represents a transient state.
known_issues.harness_action: Preserve current behavior for compatibility unless the integration task explicitly changes the loop flag.

known_issues.finding: Only idle, walk and jump exist. ATTACK resolves to idle fallback; HURT and DEAD are also mapped to idle.
known_issues.harness_action: Do not claim full action coverage for the base player. Add actions only through a separately approved scene integration change.

known_issues.finding: Frames 4, 5, 14 and 15 touch the right cell edge, creating crop risk.
known_issues.harness_action: New outputs should keep at least 1 transparent pixel on every cell edge; current frames are legacy exceptions.

known_issues.finding: A 512x384, 12-cell jump sheet exists but no current SpriteFrames resource references it.
known_issues.harness_action: Keep it as an unused candidate; do not add it to the scene automatically.

known_issues.finding: Both animation names use the same sheet, same cells and same runtime playback parameters.
known_issues.harness_action: Allow aliasing, but do not count the two names as two independent generated motions.

known_issues.finding: Several animations skip cells or use non-row-major order. Empty/unused cells are part of the current file format.
known_issues.harness_action: Consume frame_order/source_region_px from this manifest; never infer order from frame_count alone.

known_issues.finding: Identical SpriteFrames data is embedded separately in Level_03 and Level_05.
known_issues.harness_action: A texture replacement affects both, but a SpriteFrames edit must be applied to both owner scenes unless the project later creates a shared NPC scene.

harness_validation_rules.rule: Output must be PNG RGBA with transparent background, exact sheet dimensions, exact cell size and exact used source regions from the selected animation record.
Every used frame must contain at least one visible pixel; unused cells may remain fully transparent.
Resource paths must match disk case exactly and stay under res://Assets/Sprites/.
Player jump must contain a valid frame index 4 because falling code freezes that frame.
Cyber and Lingnan player attack must contain a valid, readable frame index 2 because charge/skill code freezes that frame.
New frames should keep at least one fully transparent pixel on all four cell edges; flag edge contact as crop risk.
For grounded idle/walk frames, compare bottom_y and effective_root_bottom_y against this manifest; investigate drift above 2 px unless the action intentionally leaves the ground.
Report adjacent alpha-centroid shifts and compare with quality_metrics.max_adjacent_centroid_shift_px; large jumps require visual review.
Preserve runtime_effective_fps and runtime_effective_loop, including code overrides; scene values alone are insufficient.
Review silhouette, costume, face, weapon/limb count, light direction and palette identity against the character reference sheets. Pixel statistics cannot prove identity continuity.
